metadata.title: Welcome to the learning adventure
metadata.description: Create a parent account and start a safe, playful learning adventure with your child.

welcome.title: Welcome to the learning adventure!
welcome.description: Together we discover a world full of knowledge, fun and exciting tasks. First, create an account for yourself.

metadata.title: Sign in
metadata.description: Sign in to your parent account to see how your child is doing.

signIn.title: Good to see you again!
signIn.description: Your family’s next learning adventure starts here.
signIn.continueNotice: Sign in and we will take you right back to the page you opened.

metadata.title: Set up a parent account
metadata.description: Create your parent account: it keeps settings, safety and progress for your child in one place.

signUp.title: Set up your parent account
signUp.description: With your account you manage the settings, safety and progress of your child.
signUp.name: What should we call you?
signUp.nameHint: We use it to greet you in our emails.
signUp.roleParentHint: You set up profiles for your children.
signUp.roleTeacherHint: You manage classes, material and assignments. Teachers are not verified in the MVP.
signUp.safety: For a safe and positive learning experience.
signUp.success: If {email} is new here, a confirmation link is on its way. If you already have an account, sign in instead.

confirm.title: Open the link
confirm.description: Open the email and tap the link inside.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Then sign in and the adventure can begin.

signUp.checkSpam: Nothing there yet? Have a look in your spam folder.

metadata.title: Forgot your password?
metadata.description: Ask for a link to choose a new password.

forgotPassword.title: No problem!
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.success: If there is an account for this address, a link is on its way. It works for {minutes} minutes.
forgotPassword.checkSpam: Nothing there yet? Have a look in your spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Pick something only you know. A few random words work well.
resetPassword.success: Your password is changed. You can sign in now.
resetPassword.missingToken: Something got lost on the way. Ask for a new link and we will send one right away.

emailVerification.success: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
emailVerification.failure: It has expired or was already used. Sign in and we will send you a fresh one.

errors.invalidCredentials: That did not quite fit. Check your email address and password and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: You were away for a while. Please sign in again.
errors.reauthenticationRequired: For your safety, please sign in once more.
errors.invalidToken: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your email address is not confirmed yet. We just sent you a new link.
errors.permissionDenied: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.rateLimited: That was a little fast. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.infrastructure: We cannot get through right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address yet.
validation.emailTooLong: The email address can have at most {emailMax} characters.
validation.passwordTooShort: Your password needs at least {passwordMin} characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: Your password can have at most {passwordMax} characters.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same yet.
validation.nameRequired: Please tell us what to call you.
validation.nameTooLong: The name can have at most {nameMax} characters.
validation.roleInvalid: Please choose whether you are registering as a parent or a teacher.
validation.tokenInvalid: This link is not valid. Ask for a new one.

passwordGuidance.empty: Choose a password to see how strong it is.
passwordGuidance.notCommon: Not a common password or pattern
passwordGuidance.avoidsPersonal: Does not contain your name or email
passwordGuidance.tip: Tip: four or more unrelated words make a strong password that is easy to remember.
